snippet.title: The Backworld - Official Demo Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase
snippet.description: Slip between the cracks of reality into a world where danger awaits at every turn. Survive with strategy, battling when necessary or fleeing when the odds are stacked against you. Collect strange items, unlock new abilities, and recruit unique companions. Forge your own path; every choice matters.The Backworld will be available on PC, and a demo is coming in April.
